dataset_facts.notes: 100000 eligible series -> deterministic cap; the largest raw load in the roster (~2.2 GB of float64 series).

pretraining_provenance.citation: Ansari et al., Chronos-2 (arXiv:2510.15821), Table 6 — the full list of real univariate pretraining datasets lists "Wiki".

provenance_note: `not_listed` means absent from the documentation we have. It is NOT OOD, NOT unseen and NOT held out; only `explicitly_held_out` carries an author's own exclusion statement.

model_spec.probe: ONE shared Linear(768, Q*16) applied to each of the K=4 native forecast slots; the four predicted patches concatenate to (B, Q, 64)
model_spec.readout: K = ceil(H/16) = 4 native forecast-slot token states per window
model_spec.geometry_rows: forecast slots stacked row-major, (n, 4, 768) -> (4n, 768) via probing.cka.stack_slots — the construction the committed Chronos-2 CKA analysis (run_cka_analysis --extv4-fslot) already uses
model_spec.target_space: context-standardized then arcsinh (Chronos-2's own InstanceNorm target space; id_data._make_examples)
model_spec.head_input_caveat: A final normalization (Chronos-2 L12+LN, TiRex L12+RMS) is NOT an additional model depth. It is probed and saved as a head-input diagnostic for the later native-head/alignment work, but it is excluded from the tunnel criterion, from the normalized depth axis and from the main cross-model depth curves and heatmaps. The final depth — and therefore the final-depth probe loss and the tunnel's reference — is the final BLOCK output.

series_cap.selection: seeded uniform sample without replacement over the sorted eligible series ids

extraction.note: one num_output_patches=K encoder pass per batch; the K forecast-slot token states are the native head's own input

objective: mean pinball loss over the Q*H terms of a window, then averaged over windows (probing.phase1.mean_pinball_per_window)
head_input_caveat: A final normalization (Chronos-2 L12+LN, TiRex L12+RMS) is NOT an additional model depth. It is probed and saved as a head-input diagnostic for the later native-head/alignment work, but it is excluded from the tunnel criterion, from the normalized depth axis and from the main cross-model depth curves and heatmaps. The final depth — and therefore the final-depth probe loss and the tunnel's reference — is the final BLOCK output.
tunnel_definition_caveat: The Phase-1 forecasting tunnel begins at the earliest BLOCK DEPTH after which that depth and all subsequent block depths remain within tol of the final-block VALIDATION loss (sustained entry). An isolated early crossing does not open a tunnel. The older first-crossing statistic is retained under the explicitly diagnostic name `first_crossing_<tol>` and is never called the tunnel.

generalization_at_entrance.note: descriptive; the tunnel is selected on validation and never on test

wd_selection.meaning: a selected weight decay at the grid MAXIMUM is reported as a decision to make, never silently accepted. Read it together with val_loss_over_constant_forecast_floor below: a ratio near 1 means the depth's validation optimum IS the no-information floor (a finding), a ratio well below 1 means the search really was cut off (widen the grid)

constant_forecast_floor.predictor: per-step quantiles of the TRAIN targets (the pinball-optimal constant)
constant_forecast_floor.fit: closed form — no optimizer, so no weight decay can reach or distort it

wql.statistic: sum(numerator) / sum(denominator), formed inside each replicate

native_baseline.source: Chronos2Pipeline.predict_quantiles at the Phase-1 quantile levels

mase_definition: MASE is normalized by the seasonal-naive error computed over the 512-step context window using the dataset-specific seasonal period.

geometry.row_construction: forecast slots stacked row-major, (n, 4, 768) -> (4n, 768) via probing.cka.stack_slots — the construction the committed Chronos-2 CKA analysis (run_cka_analysis --extv4-fslot) already uses

unbiased.meaning: biased-linear-CKA value for two INDEPENDENT Gaussian representations of this shape; the true CKA there is 0, so this is the estimator's own upward bias floor at this (n, d). NOT subtracted from the reported matrix

biased.meaning: biased-linear-CKA value for two INDEPENDENT Gaussian representations of this shape; the true CKA there is 0, so this is the estimator's own upward bias floor at this (n, d). NOT subtracted from the reported matrix

geometry.cka_axis: block_depth only (a final normalization is not a model depth)
geometry.geometry_caveat: Unbiased linear CKA is the Phase-1 headline. The biased estimator is saved as a diagnostic but its finite-sample floor differs across the three models because the number of readout rows per window and the representation dimension differ (Chronos-2: 4 rows per window at d=768; TimesFM-3: 1 at d=1280; TiRex headline pos0: 1 at d=512). Absolute biased CKA must NEVER be compared across models. The measured per-(n, d, estimator) null floor is saved beside every matrix and nothing is subtracted from the matrices.

regeneration_note: every Phase-1 figure is regenerable from this directory without re-running a foundation model: layerwise curves from layer_metrics.csv, the validation tunnel decision from tunnel.json, uncertainty at any B from bootstrap_inputs.npz, CKA heatmaps from cka/, effective rank and full spectra from effective_rank.csv + spectral_metrics.npz, and calibration / per-window distributions from predictions_*.npz
cross_model_loss_caveat: Each model is probed where its OWN head reads, in its OWN normalized target space (Chronos-2: context-standardized + arcsinh at the K=4 forecast slots; TimesFM-3: detrend + RevIN at the last real context token; TiRex: per-pass loc/scale at the two native forecast-producing states). The absolute Q=9 mean pinball loss is therefore NOT comparable ACROSS models. Cross-model comparison is valid for (a) the tunnel entrance, which is a within-model ratio against that model's own final depth, and (b) MASE, which is in raw units under one shared in-context seasonal-naive denominator.
